components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-priority actions such as analyzing a URL or starting registration.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #790D2B; color: #fff; padding: 10px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 14px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(77,7,27,0.3); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5F0A22; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #4D071B; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #790D2B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions that should remain clear without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #17171C; padding: 10px 24px; border: 1px solid #E7E4E8; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 14px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, border-color 200ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F7F7FA; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #790D2B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet, low-emphasis actions in toolbars and navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #686873; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: 500 14px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #EDEDF1; color: #17171C; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #790D2B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: URL Input
components.description: Full-width field for entering or pasting a URL for analysis.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-url">URL to check</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-url" inputmode="url" placeholder="https://example.com" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: #17171C; font: 600 14px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #17171C; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #E7E4E8; border-radius: 12px; font: 400 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #C9C6CE; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: #790D2B; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(121,13,43,0.2); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #790D2B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #F7F7FA; color: #686873; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Neutral content container for dashboard summaries, lists, and analysis details.
components.html:
Recent analysis

Review your latest link checks.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #17171C; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #E7E4E8; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,23,28,0.05), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(23,23,28,0.12); font: 400 16px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #686873; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #F0C9D4; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(23,23,28,0.06), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(121,13,43,0.18); }

components.name: Safe Badge
components.description: Compact safe verdict; pair its color with an icon and text.
components.css: .ds-badge-safe { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; background: rgba(22,132,91,0.1); color: #116A49; border: 1px solid rgba(22,132,91,0.25); border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 12px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-safe svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Suspicious Badge
components.description: Cautious amber verdict for a suspicious link.
components.css: .ds-badge-suspicious { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; background: rgba(199,131,22,0.1); color: #A66E12; border: 1px solid rgba(199,131,22,0.3); border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 12px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-suspicious svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Dangerous Badge
components.description: Red verdict for a dangerous link, paired with a label and icon.
components.html: Dangerous
components.css: .ds-badge-dangerous { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; background: rgba(198,40,61,0.1); color: #A71F31; border: 1px solid rgba(198,40,61,0.25); border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 12px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-dangerous svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Active Navigation Link
components.description: Indicates the current route in the app sidebar.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #686873; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font: 500 14px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-nav-link svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #17171C; background: #EDEDF1; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #5F0A22; background: #F8E9EE; border-color: rgba(121,13,43,0.15); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #790D2B; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
PHISHWARE's web interface is a clear, reassuring, educational place to assess a link and decide what to do next. It pairs a practical dashboard and persistent navigation with small, legible status cues. The overall impression is capable and approachable, not alarmist: safe, suspicious, and dangerous states are distinct, sober messages rather than fear-driven decoration.

Inter and compact controls keep the interface direct and easy to scan. The wine-and-raspberry brand colors identify primary actions, while pale neutral surfaces, subtle borders, and restrained shadows carry most of the structure. The UI supports light and dark themes and a Spanish-first experience with English localization.
keyCharacteristics: Burgundy brand accent with restrained semantic risk colors
Rounded controls and layered neutral surfaces
Light and dark themes; Spanish-first interface

rules.name: The Risk-Color Rule
rules.body: Reserve green, amber, and red for safe, suspicious, and dangerous states respectively; keep these indicators legible and sober rather than alarmist.

rules.name: The Readable-Risk Rule
rules.body: Keep verdicts, explanations, and actionable labels in the sans-serif hierarchy; use monospace for literal URLs and technical values, not whole paragraphs.

rules.name: The Quiet-Layer Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal separation first; reserve the stronger shadow for interactive hover feedback.

dos: Do use the existing wine brand ramp for primary actions and selected navigation.
Do preserve the mapping of green to safe, amber to suspicious, and red to dangerous.
Do retain light/dark theme behavior, Spanish-first copy, and the English locale.
Do keep visible focus treatment and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do use JetBrains Mono for URLs and technical values.
Do pair risk color with an icon and a text verdict.
donts: Don't use alarmist visuals or amplify fear around threat states.
Don't use danger red for ordinary primary actions or decorative emphasis.
Don't replace the established logo, shield identity, or wine brand palette without an explicit redesign.
Don't make safe, suspicious, or dangerous status understandable by color alone.
Don't add heavy shadows to every surface or make the dashboard denser than its existing responsive grids.
